info.title: PurposePath Integration API
info.description: Integration Service API - MEASURE Integration configuration, credentials management, and Python AI backend communication endpoints

get.summary:
Get decrypted connection credentials.
Returns credentials in system-specific format (Salesforce, HubSpot, QuickBooks, etc.).
This endpoint logs all access for audit compliance.
Detailed health check with dependency status

Get MEASURE integration configuration for execution.
Returns complete configuration needed for MEASURE data collection.

post.summary:
Test a single integration execution without persisting measured values.
SQL template may be generated/persisted as part of normal template lifecycle if missing.

get.summary:
Get all active MEASURE integrations for scheduled execution.
Returns paginated list of integrations that are active and due for execution.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 100, max: 1000)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default: 0)

post.summary:
Enqueue active integrations to SQS for asynchronous execution.
This decouples scheduler selection from downstream retrieval and execution.

externalProvider.description: External provider name when external reference mode is used.

credentials.description:
Decrypted credentials as key-value pairs.
Structure depends on system type:
- Salesforce: instanceUrl, accessToken, refreshToken, clientId, clientSecret
- HubSpot: apiKey, portalId
- QuickBooks: accessToken, refreshToken, realmId, clientId, clientSecret

tokensExpired.description: Whether the OAuth tokens are expired and need refresh

lastHealthCheckAtUtc.description: Last health check timestamp in UTC.

lastConnectionErrorAtUtc.description: Last connection-level error timestamp in UTC.

lastConnectionTestedBy.description: Actor/system identifier of last health check operation.

tokenExpiresAt.description: When the OAuth tokens expire (if applicable)

ConnectionCredentialsResponse.description:
Response containing decrypted connection credentials for Python service.
The credentials structure varies based on system type.

EnqueueActiveIntegrationsResponse.description: Result of active integration queue-enqueue operation.
